topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I can't stop thinking about what I told Alex. I shouldn't have let it slide, pretending everything was fine. After all these years, I trusted that the stories about climbing the corporate ladder were true. But knowing now that it was all a fabrication, I feel like I should have seen the signs. Maybe I was just afraid of what it would mean for our friendship if I questioned it. I wish I could take back my hollow congratulations from last night. It’s not too late to talk, to maybe help Alex find a way forward, but I’m afraid of how deep this goes.
